title: Does a seasonal conclusion survive changing satellites?
limits: Specified after count-based Indonesia validation and case results had been inspected, before computing this decision benchmark. Evaluation years excluded from fitting are not an untouched benchmark.

Retrospective diagnostic support: baseline median >=5 and concurrent Aqua and VIIRS occupied counts both >=20. Same gate for every model, no tuning. This does not establish clear-sky coverage and cannot operate unchanged after Aqua retires.

Five study rectangles pooled with equal region-month weight; some rectangles overlap and observations are not independent. Also publish each region and year; no population inference or confidence interval.

Aqua is reference, not ground truth. Report every method even if released calibration loses. No headline replacement or coefficient changes automatically follow this diagnostic. External practitioner validation deferred.
